simple.meaning: מָשׁוֹט (mâshôwṭ) is a Hebrew word meaning “an oar.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4880. mashowt מָשׁוֺט noun [masculine] oar ; — מ ׳תֹּפְשֵׂי Ezek 27:29 . [ מָשׁוֺט ] noun [masculine] id.; plural suffix מִשּׁוֺטַ֫יִךְ Ezek 27:6 (Kö ii. 153 , compare Ges § 72e ), made of oak-trees.

occurrences.englishText: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan.
